prompt: rgb.jpg is a horizontal strip of 5 frames, left to right in time order, sampled from the few seconds of a head-mounted (egocentric) video; the camera wearer is the viewpoint. Describe the spatial understanding this image supports: the layout of the scene; which people and objects are present and roughly how far each is from the camera wearer (in metres) and from each other; relative positions (left/right/in front/behind, above/below); which way people face and whether they look toward the camera wearer; what is within arm's reach of the camera wearer or of others; occlusions and anything partly out of view; and how these change across the 5 frames (approach, retreat, turning). Describe only spatial facts. Do not guess anyone's intentions, social norms, or what anyone should do. Return only JSON: {"rgb": "..."} with 4-6 sentences.

descriptions.rgb: Across all five frames, the camera wearer stands directly in front of a checkout counter, with the countertop about 0.4–0.8 m away and a large red-and-white promotional mat lying flat near the center. A cashier stands behind the counter roughly 1–1.5 m from the camera, facing generally toward the wearer, although the head and much of the upper body are cropped out; one hand repeatedly extends over or rests near the mat within the cashier’s arm’s reach. A payment-terminal area and card-logo stickers remain near the camera wearer’s right side, while a small white paper or receipt lies farther right on the counter, approximately 0.5–0.8 m from the mat. From frames 1–3, the viewpoint shifts rightward and slightly closer, moving the mat from center-left toward center and revealing more of the cashier’s right-side workspace. In frames 4–5, a black compartmented organizer or register tray becomes prominent on the right, about 0.7–1 m from the camera, while another person in a dark quilted jacket appears partly cropped at the far right and faces the counter rather than clearly looking at the camera wearer. The counter blocks the lower bodies of both people, and the wearer’s dark hand or held object briefly enters the lower foreground near the mat, within immediate arm’s reach.
